review.readiness_note: Sign off the captured 390px layout. The supplied Lab image is Profile, not an inbox specification, so this is a system-level approval. review.why: Frame Shift has been transferred appropriately to an inbox rather than copied literally from Profile. The mineral surface, typography, muted metadata, flat separators and restrained cobalt match the approved language. All three rows expose distinct work context beneath the person, followed by a message preview and readable time; truncation stays within the text column. The unread total agrees with the single visibly New conversation. No financial summary is invented: payment wording remains a message preview. The business image and initial fallbacks are modest identity elements, while all five bottom navigation labels fit without clipping. The large remaining blank area honestly reflects a short inbox, not missing design content. No concrete implementation drift is visible.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift is faithfully applied to the production inbox, with its real conversations, states and navigation visibly preserved at 390px.
